body: Quick pass @ fce68299: merges cleanly with main; quick gate green on this head (motion, app, ui; 0 failed); `clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -D warnings` clean; body complete (root cause with the 3xD reach geometry, pins + mutations, three moved Ø20/6 mm tests named, Changelog, Fixes #1556). #1556 re-rated P1 (free core after verify ok). Follow-ups #1565 (P8), #1566 (P7). Flagged ready for review (safety tier).

Review fix pushed: 6b32774771498ee829a14ae9a3dce64d4f03f2e0

Answers pullrequestreview-5899268871.

**Blocking**
1. **Bull nose (and ball) on a through hole: fixed.** `BoreParams` now carries `corner_radius`, and generate passes the op tool's `corner_r`. A through hole is judged at its floor plane, where the tip runs `THROUGH_CLEAR` = 1 mm below. There the cutter reaches `(r - cr) + sqrt(a (2 cr - a))` when `a < cr`, and `r` otherwise. The limit is `d + 4 reach + 2 leave`, which is `3d + 2 leave` for a square end mill. The math lives in the new `machining2d::bore_core` (`cutting_radius_at`, `bore_floor_reach`, `bore_core_gap`, `bore_leaves_core`, `max_bore_diameter`). The refusal names the corner's reach. A corner that does not fit the cutter is refused by name.
   - Ø12 r2: the limit is 34.928 mm. 34.928 bores, and its floor inside the ring's band is covered. 34.948 is refused with "up to 34.928 mm".
   - Ø6 ball: the limit is 14.944 mm.
   - Blind holes keep the full-radius limit: the ridge stands on the floor and never comes loose. The decision file says so and gives the full torus derivation.
2. **detect_holes survivors: killed.** Detect has no comparison of its own any more. It asks the kernel door's own verdict, `bore_leaves_core`, with the same corner and through allowance generate uses. The new pin `bore_reach::tests::detect_keeps_the_limit_hole_with_its_leave_and_names_the_one_past_it` (4 mm tool, 0.5 leave) keeps Ø13.000 and names Ø13.02. Ignoring the leave and dropping the at-limit hole are both killed (table in the PR body).

**Non-blocking**
- **Overlap margin at the limit: not taken.** Touching stays covered. A 1 µm margin guards nothing a spindle can see. A real one (a few hundredths, for runout) would move every printed limit off the round `3d + 2 leave` and hold this op stricter than every pocket stepover, which also uses nominal geometry. The posted arcs' chords only widen the overlap. The reasoning is in the decision file; revisit with #1566.
- **camcraft-mcp skill row for `skipped`:** filed as #1584 (P5, effort:low; it is a process file, so it is not touched here).
- **Old saved projects keep their cored path and stamp:** noted on #1565 (https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/1565#issuecomment-6867276555), with a verify-time `bore_leaves_core` check as the cheap close.
- **state.rs +26:** flagged in the PR body only.

**New pins:** `bore_core_tests::{the_cutting_radius_follows_the_corner_torus, a_bull_nose_through_hole_is_judged_at_its_floor_reach, a_ball_through_hole_and_a_corner_that_does_not_fit_are_judged}`, `bore_reach::tests::{detect_keeps_the_limit_hole_with_its_leave_and_names_the_one_past_it, detect_judges_a_bull_nose_through_hole_at_its_floor_reach}`, and `tests/bore_core.rs::a_bull_nose_through_bore_is_judged_by_its_corner_at_detect_and_generate` (MCP, a custom Ø12 r2 tool). I ran 10 mutations and all 10 were killed; the table is in the PR body.

**Gate:** `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green on 6b327747 (motion 185 s, app 728 s, ui 61 s; 16.3 min wall). Clippy (`-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -D warnings`) is clean. The branch still merges cleanly with upstream/main.

The PR stays a draft.
